raw_text: Bellingcat AI Media Analysis: The viral image of a 'stealth drone over Ladakh' is confirmed to be AI-generated. Our analysis identified multiple telltale artifacts: inconsistent shadow directions, warped text on the drone body, six-fingered mountain reflections in the fuselage, and metadata showing Midjourney generation parameters. No EXIF camera data exists. This is a digital art creation, not military intelligence.
clean_text: Bellingcat confirms stealth drone image is AI-generated. Artifacts include inconsistent shadows, warped text, and Midjourney metadata. No EXIF camera data. Digital art, not military intelligence.
